dedupe_keys.name: centrifuge tests on pile supported wharves subjected to combined inertial and lateral ground deformation loads

description: Centrifuge tests on pile-supported wharves subjected to combined inertial and lateral ground deformation loads is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Arash Khosravifar, Portland State University (pdx.edu). The main objective of this research is to characterize the interaction between superstructure inertial loads and lateral ground deformation demands on pile foundations. This objective will be achieved through two large-scale geotechnical centrifuge tests conducted at the Natural Hazards Engineering Research Infrastructure (NHERI) facility at UC Davis. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Seismic, Pile foundation, Liquefaction. Published 2025-09-22. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
